name: SPC tool offset update
description: Update a tool offset using Statistical Process Control (SPC). The correction is applied from the average value of a configurable sequence of measurements.

parameters.description: Tool offset number to be updated.
Base spare tool offset used by the SPC algorithm. Offset M stores the accumulated average value and offset M+1 stores the measurement counter.

optional_parameters.description: Tolerance zone in which no corrective tool offset update is applied.
Number of consecutive out-of-tolerance measurements required before the corrective action is applied.
Feedback percentage applied to the calculated tool offset correction.
When present, updates the tool length offset register. If omitted, the tool radius offset register is updated. Used only with Type C tool offsets.
